newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins edge up to new level - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins edge up to new level - dealers.

text.p: Russian MinFin bonds edged up on market relief that Russia's lower chamber of parliament had not passed a resolution calling for President Boris Yeltsin's dismissal and dealers said prices had stabilised at new levels.
The State Duma agreed on Wednesday to postpone a final vote on a motion to remove Yeltsin on health grounds to give deputies time for more discussion.
Experts from parliament's legal department have said a parliamentary declaration is not enough to start impeachment procedures.
"Everyone was glad the Duma did not impeach Yeltsin so the mood has been bullish since morning," one dealer said.
Dealers said some major London operators were seen investing actively today, but prices failed to firm further as other banks seemed to be closing long positions.
"The market is fairly quiet, stabilising at these levels -- there is no news to make it either worried or happy," Eurobank dealer Olivier Coursault said.
